acceptanceEvidence: Migration 20261017190000 adds contentSchemaVersion (default 1) and nullable templateVersion; tests/vc1-vc2-content-integration.test.ts inserts a populated version-1 revision, points the live site at it and proves identical text, unknown key hidden, row unchanged after a new save.

src/domains/site-content/types.ts and values.ts define text, link, image, list, promotion and hidden with strict checks; tests/vc1-content-values.test.ts covers plain text, one nesting level, whole-number focus 0 to 100, UTC times with end after start, and a wrong kind as an explicit error.

src/domains/site-content/links.ts allows only known pages and anchors, https addresses, and phone/email from the business profile, adds noopener noreferrer to outside links; tests cover credentials, protocol-relative, javascript and data refusals.

src/domains/site-content/fields.ts describes every field (label, help, page, section, where, kind, starting text, optional, limits, placeholders, anchor) and declares eight business facts with their owner screens in SITE_FACT_SOURCES; the registry test checks every existing key maps to itself and has complete metadata.

src/domains/site-content/codec.ts reads versions 1 and 2, treats missing as the starting text, intentional empty and hidden as different, keeps unknown keys out of view, and refuses unknown keys on save; publish also refuses a draft carrying unknown keys; covered by the unit and integration tests.

src/domains/site-content/index.ts reads through the codec (published content, revision preview, editor state) so text readers get identical strings; new drafts are written as version 2 with template classic-1; the integration test proves old rows are never rewritten and the existing site-content integration tests still pass.

Migration 20261017200000 creates WebsiteAsset with DRAFT/PUBLIC/RETIRED, hash, type, size, who and when; pictures resolve only in that table; the integration test shows a job/customer photo id and a storage path cannot be published or saved as a website picture.

uploadWebsiteAsset requires an active owner/admin, sniffs the real type, limits 10 MB and 24 megapixels, removes metadata, writes a deterministic WebP at a server-made key; tests refuse SVG, HTML, a remote address, empty, disguised and oversize files and prove nothing is stored.

/api/desk/site-media/[assetId] needs an active owner/admin and is private no-store; /api/site-media/[assetId] serves only PUBLIC with image/webp, nosniff, immutable cache and no token; draft, retired and unknown give the same 404; covered in tests/vc2-website-assets.test.ts.

publishDraft and restoreRevision call promoteReferencedAssets inside the pointer-locked transaction: only referenced pictures become public, and a missing, retired or unstored picture blocks with a message naming the field and changes nothing; integration tests prove the spare picture stays private.

retireWebsiteAsset refuses anything used by the live version, the open draft or a catalog photo and never deletes bytes; restoring a version that needs a retired picture is blocked; cleanupStaleDraftAssets removes only old unused drafts; integration test covers old, in-use, fresh and public pictures.

Without configured private storage uploads answer a plain message and nothing falls back to production storage (getPrivatePhotoStore is the only source); the catalog setter keeps bundled pictures selectable; ImageCropPreview shows wide, square and tall crops from the stored focus point and decorative choice (tests/vc2-crop-preview.test.tsx); the owner screen that edits them is V-C4.

setAppliancePhotoUrl now checks an active owner/admin inside a transaction, accepts https, the bundled /appliances pictures already in use, or an uploaded website picture (made public on save), and writes the audit record in the same transaction; integration test covers staff refusal, bad addresses, promotion and audit count.

externalAcceptance: Real use after the daily release: the owner uploading a real picture needs the private picture store configured in production (the same private store used for photos); with it missing the owner sees a plain message and the live site is unchanged. The owner screens that use pictures arrive in V-C4.
Browser and accessibility checks of the changed pages run in exact-head CI.
Website picture bytes are not yet in the daily recovery media copy (rows are in the database backup); noted in STATUS and the runbook.
evidence: Bundle V-C1+V-C2; planning commit f3d08616942aa08b7ff921d9efc052de01d0be39 preserved.

Local: typecheck and lint pass; 16 unit tests of the value, link, version-reading and registry rules (vc1-content-values), 13 unit tests of image cleaning, storage paths, the three routes and their access rules (vc2-website-assets), a crop-preview render test, and 10 real-Postgres tests (populated upgrade, upload roles and reuse, publish promotion, text-only saves keep pictures, blocked publish for missing/retired/unstored/foreign ids, retire and restore rules, cleanup, catalog setter) pass; the older site-content tests were updated for the new storage shape; the full run passes apart from one earlier date test (custody backfill, Denver midnight) that failed before this work; exact-head CI pending.
